We are accelerating very fast toward $1B in RWA volume.

The most important thing for me is that everyone is winning on LONG. It doesn’t matter if you were trading on Launcher 1 or 2, Sol or Base.

The design and culture we built starting with $AI makes our assets explosive, but also extremely sustainable because of the deep liquidity design.

LONG pairs are now controlling 50% of the circulating supply of multiple stocks.

One thing I want to explain:

When a stock pair reaches this level of liquidity and stock supply control, it graduates into a new status.

A “legacy” asset.

It becomes extremely hard to vamp because the liquidity and supply concentration create a massive moat. At the same time, stock related activity, narratives and price movements can be reflected in the pair.

PVP is largely a byproduct of rotating flows into assets with extremely thin LP. The only thing keeping them alive is constant extreme flow.

With deep LP, explosive movements compound into deeper liquidity instead.

You can sit on an entry, let the market develop and gradually allocate more to your longfolio.

Your only job as a holder is to pick stocks and setups you believe in, hold, spread the movement and enjoy the upside.

LONG.

posts.text:
A GOVERNMENT WATCHDOG GOT DECLAWED SO DONALD TRUMP'S SON COULD KEEP CASHING IN ON ONLINE BETS

The CFTC is supposed to police crypto and betting markets. Instead it's being hollowed out in real time while Don Jr. sits as an adviser to the exact platforms it's supposed to regulate

Two staffers who dared question Polymarket's safeguards are gone. One put on administrative leave and investigated until she quit. The other, the acting head of market oversight, shown the door entirely

You know who replaces skeptics at a regulatory agency? Nobody who asks hard questions twice

The former CFTC chair didn't even wait for the ink to dry on his exit paperwork before landing a job at a crypto company that partners directly with Polymarket

Donald Trump's son is an unpaid adviser to Polymarket and Kalshi, an investor through 1789 Capital, and somehow none of that qualifies as a conflict worth mentioning in any official memo

Billions in new wealth flowing into crypto and prediction markets while the one agency built to protect ordinary bettors gets gutted from the inside

Ordinary people betting on these platforms have zero idea the cops just got sent home

This isn't deregulation. This is clearing the field so the Trump family's bets pay out bigger

Every whistleblower who gets pushed out is a warning shot to the next one thinking about speaking up

Trump didn't need to sign an order to do this. He just needed to let the right people walk out the door and the wrong people walk in

This is the pattern now. Not chaos. Architecture

They are not going to stop until every watchdog in Washington reports to the family instead of the public
